notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.16.1
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Unlock progress made during a run is shown on the end of run screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where frost spray spell wasn’t working when using certain pulsers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various visual bugs with spells and enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few sound effects that were too quiet[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.16.0
notes.notes: [list][*][p]New boss[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Four new pulsers[/p][list][*][p]The clock[/p][list][*][p]A wind up device that automatically pulses as it ticks downward. Once both halves of the clock are in contact and it is fully closed it will stop pulsing, and you need to wind it back up. There’s no pulsing while it’s winding, so you need to time it carefully.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The orb[/p][list][*][p]Throw it to emit a long lasting pulse where it hits. It also marks enemies near the collision point, and deals high damage on a direct hit.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The eye[/p][list][*][p]Pressing the pulse input opens the eye for a short time and grants true sight until the eye closes. It has a cooldown until it can be opened again. (i guess technically it doesn’t actually pulse but it still lets you see)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The skull[/p][list][*][p]Emits a constant pulse that grows larger as your health depletes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p]Assists[/p][list][*][p]In the settings menu you can enable optional stat buffs for damage resistance, primary fire damage, pulse duration, and max stamina. You can set each stat to either +50%, +100%, or “incremental.” In incremental mode, the stat will be increased by 2% each time you die, up to a max of +100%.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p]Boss always remains visible[/p][/*][*][p]End of run stats screen fades in much more quickly[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug with the pulser that occurred when dying after casting a spell[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed spell UI appearing as not-usable when starting a new run if you died after casting a spell on the previous run[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.15.1
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Fixed issue with overlapping tutorial text and out of bounds text[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented completing the tutorial[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.15.0
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Unlock additional perk equip slots[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock special perks by surviving runs at different difficulty levels. The first 3 of 9 of these perks are implemented in this update.[/p][list][*][p]Extra Life: Once per run, return to full health after dying.[/p][/*][*][p]Decoy: Dashing while at full stamina creates a decoy that draws enemy attention for a brief time.[/p][/*][*][p]Spell Crystals: Instead of restoring health when destroyed, health crystals restore whichever spell is the least charged (100% charge restored if light spell, 25% charge restored if heavy spell). If all spells are fully charged, the crystal heals you.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Progress towards unlocking perks, loadout, etc. is now shown on the icon in addition to the tooltip, so you can see all your progress at a glance.[/p][/*][*][p]Spells now have names[/p][/*][*][p]Minor tweaks to enemy spawns[/p][/*][*][p]Fleeting Vision blessing replaced with Sentry: Gain true sight while standing still.[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltip for “shield” keyword[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial text uses a more readable font[/p][/*][*][p]Increased save/load performance. No more long hitches while saving.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed octo tentacle animation not stopping while frozen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed blight UI overlapping with health bar on some resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that was causing save data to sometimes load incorrectly[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.14.0
notes.notes: [h3]Version 0.14.0[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Secondary Fire[/p][list][*][p]Replaces precision fire mode with different selectable secondary fire types.[/p][list][*][p]Sniper: a high precision, long range shot (this is what was previously the precision fire)[/p][/*][*][p]Wave Shot: a wide, slow moving projectile that pierces all targets[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]No longer gain secondary ammo by killing enemies, but ammo crystals appear more often and more perks provide different ways of gaining secondary ammo.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Shields[/p][list][*][p]Certain upgrades and abilities give you shields, which block one instance of damage and then break.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Overflow[/p][list][*][p]Certain upgrades and abilities overflow your primary ammo, which temporarily fills it beyond its normal maximum capacity.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Blessings[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blessing now have names[/p][/*][*][p]Removed blessing category that was specific to precision fire. Some of these blessings (e.g. true sight on aim and stamina refill on precision kill) have been converted to trigger off of secondary fire and have been moved into different categories.[/p][/*][*][p]Four new blessings focusing on health and shields:[/p][list][*][p]Extra Protection: Gain 1 shield when destroying a health crystal.[/p][/*][*][p]Deflect: Push away nearby enemies when you lose a shield.[/p][/*][*][p]Lifeline: Health crystals spawn more often.[/p][/*][*][p]Explosive Recovery: Health crystals explode when destroyed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved blessings:[/p][list][*][p]Conditioning: Dashing costs 50% less stamina.[/p][/*][*][p]Replenishing Dash: Dashing refills 50% of your primary ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Transfer of Power: Secondary fire kills increase primary fire damage by 10% to a max of +50%. Reloading resets the damage bonus.[/p][/*][*][p]Under Pressure: Primary fire damage increases as its ammo decreases. +5% damage for each shot below max ammo capacity.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Perks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Perks now have names[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Perks have been overhauled. Instead of small, incremental upgrades that are leveled up multiple times, perks are now one-time unlocks that are significantly more impactful right from the start. All perks are either completely new or have had their effects improved.[/p][/*][*][p]New perks:[/p][list][*][p]Infusion: Casting your light spell completely refills primary ammo, and casting your heavy spell overflows it by +100%.[/p][/*][*][p]Quickcharge: Quick reload restores 10% light spell charge.[/p][/*][*][p]Linger: +100% enemy status effect duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Kill Tally: Killing 5 enemies with primary fire refills 1 secondary ammo. Reloading resets the count.[/p][/*][*][p]Quickbreak: Quick reload destroys all health and ammo crystals.[/p][/*][*][p]Voidguard: Gain 1 shield after remaining undamaged for 45 seconds, and start with 2 shields (each shield negates all damage one time).[/p][/*][*][p]Endurance: +50% stamina recharge rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Pain Response: Emit a pulse when damaged.[/p][/*][*][p]Shrouded Recovery: +100% stamina recharge rate when no pulses are active.[/p][/*][*][p]Quickpulse: Emit a pulse when performing a quick reload[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved perks:[/p][list][*][p]Primary Reserves: +50% primary ammo capacity.[/p][/*][*][p]Secondary Reserves: +50% secondary ammo capacity.[/p][/*][*][p]Body and Mind: Restore 10% health on level up.[/p][/*][*][p]Invigoration: When stamina is below 50%, collecting an XP pickup restores a small amount of stamina.[/p][/*][*][p]Blightbane: -50% blight durations.[/p][/*][*][p]Tempo: +50% pulse rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Sustain: +50% pulse duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Focused Recall: Your pulser returns 50% faster after casting a spell.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Difficulty Modifiers[/b][/p][list][*][p]Difficulty modifiers now apply a multiplier to currency earned at the end of a run[/p][/*][*][p]New difficulty modifiers:[/p][list][*][p]Headrush: Dashing dissipates all pulses.[/p][/*][*][p]Jumpstart: Stamina doesn't start recharging until you reload.[/p][/*][*][p]Contaminated: Whenever a blight appears while leveling up, all blessing choices are blighted.[/p][/*][*][p]Heavy Munitions: -10% move speed per secondary ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Crabwalk: You can only move left and right.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Balance Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the number of enemy spawns later in the run. Should be much more manageable at the default difficulty level.[/p][/*][*][p]If no enemies are alive, an extra group of enemies will spawn. So if you’re efficient at clearing out enemies you’ll get a few more to keep you busy, but if not then they will just spawn at the normal rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased size of wyrm enemy to make it easier to hit[/p][/*][*][p]Accuracy of wyrm projectiles decreases the further away the player is[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 0.5 second period of invulnerability after taking damage[/p][/*][*][p]Grenade light spell now also poisons enemies in a large radius around the explosion[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased damage falloff of sniper secondary fire (*previously precision fire)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased amount of health restored from health crystals[/p][/*][*][p]Health crystals now apply healing instantly[/p][/*][*][p]Ammo crystals now always completely fill secondary ammo[/p][/*][*][p]Increased poison duration and significantly increased poison damage[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Misc. Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Save system has been rewritten to make future content additions/changes easier to deal with. Because of this, save data will be reset with this update.[/p][/*][*][p]Separate inputs for quick reload and shoot. No more accidentally failing the quick reload because you were spamming the trigger.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing tab brings up tooltips for all currently on-screen keywords[/p][/*][*][p]Improved feedback on player health and stamina bars[/p][/*][*][p]True sight now only uses the portal VFX for certain abilities. For abilities that trigger very frequently true sight instantly applies across the entire screen without waiting for the portal to open.[/p][/*][*][p]Run timer now counts down instead of up (it was always the case that runs had a max duration of 25 minutes, so counting down should make that more obvious)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved flash pulse VFX on level up[/p][/*][*][p]New wyrm enemy projectile VFX[/p][/*][*][p]Changed colour of turret spawn VFX to make it more visible[/p][/*][*][p]UI icons scale better at different resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Boss health bar has the same VFX as the player health bar[/p][/*][*][p]Selected loadout appears on pause screen[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to various enemy telegraph SFX, which should make it easier to locate enemies using sound when they spawn or perform certain actions[/p][/*][*][p]Ammo crystals added to the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Much higher quality desktop shortcut icon (to get the new icon, uninstall the playtest and then reinstall it)[/p][/*][*][p]Various optimizations and performance improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed lightning strike blessing sometimes not triggering[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text boxes sometimes not displaying at the right size[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text boxes sometimes going off-screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text boxes sometimes not highlighting keywords[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed firing VFX freezing and staying alive too long when firing then immediately exiting aiming mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several UI visual bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several visual glitches that occurred while true sight is active[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text not fitting on the blessing selection screen with certain blessing/blight combinations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed blessing and blight icons not fitting on the pause screen after reaching a certain amount of them[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.13.0
notes.notes:
- Difficulty modifier system
- XP pickups give 50% more XP
- Replaced [i]increased rate of precision fire[/i] blessing with one that adds projectile piercing to primary fire
- Swapped order of [i]true sight on dash[/i] blessing and [i]true sight on damaged[/i] blessing
- Lots of visual updates and improvements to UI across the game
- Added a button to change the sort order of blessings in the pause menu

- Fixed squid enemy always missing its beam attack
- Fixed enemies not playing death VFX if dying while frozen
- Fixed several visual bugs when destroying crystals
- Fixed tooltip windows sometimes being too large
- Lots of various performance optimizations

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.12.3
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where you could apply multiple copies of the same perk if purchasing them in a specific order
- UI should now scale properly across different aspect ratios
- Various minor UI and font changes

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.12.2
notes.notes:
- Fixed exploding enemies sometimes spawning with their explosion warning highlight enabled
- Fixed radar blessing UI covering the run timer
- Fixed an unintentional infinitely stacking damage resistance buff that quickly made you invincible

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.12.1
notes.notes:
- Additional VFX for light ice spell
- Fixed some issues with player projectile spawn positions looking a little wonky when changing the FOV
- Fixed ice spells not despawning when returning to the main menu
- Fixed boss not despawning when returning to the main menu
- Fixed gameplay SFX still playing after a run ends

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.12.0
notes.notes:
- Ice spells
- Main menu music
- Exploding enemies don’t explode if killed while frozen
- Knockback blessing replaced with new blessing that increases primary fire damage on precision kills
- New VFX for frozen enemies
- New VFX for automatic primary fire impact
- Repeat application of a status effect refreshes the duration of the effect
- Abilities that charge and spawn crystals now use consistent language in their descriptions, and they use a new UI element for showing charge progress
- Purchasing a perk equips it if there are enough slots available
- Fixed bug where some blessings that refill ammo were not working correctly
- Fixed bug where some enemy animations would continue while enemy was frozen

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.11.3
notes.notes:
- Fire light spell triggers a fast and long lasting pulse when cast
- Decreased overall game audio volume
- Fixed fire light spell kills counting at precision kills
- Fixed pulses sometimes being full size for a few frames after spawning

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.11.2
notes.notes:
- Fire crystal blessing (replaces blessing that ignited enemies on precision fire hits)
- New SFX for fire light spell

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.11.1
notes.notes:
- Fire heavy spell now ignites enemies in a large radius around the explosion
- Fire light spell now pierces targets infinitely

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.11.0
notes.notes:
- Fire heavy spell
- Fire light spell
- Ammo crystal that gives precision ammo and refills primary ammo when destroyed
- Precision ammo is gained more quickly
- Visual and audio feedback to show when an enemy is about to explode
- Perk that gives precision ammo when destroying a crystal now gives a chance to gain precision ammo (up to 100% chance at max level)
- Fixed a few visual bugs with the pulse VFX

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.10.2
notes.notes:
- Greatly increased the radius of several player abilities and elemental effects
- Fixed bug where ice crystals were not despawning on end of run
- Fixed bug that was causing hand animations to stop playing before completion

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.10.1
notes.notes:
- You can now use precision fire while your primary fire is reloading
- Added an indicator to the stamina bar that shows how much stamina it will cost to dash
- When stamina bar refills to 100%, it flashes yellow and plays a sound
- Better visual feedback when failing a quick reload
- Fixed bug where doing a quick reload would sometimes immediately shoot afterwards

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.10.0
notes.notes:
- Basic gameplay tutorial
- Various minor balance tweaks
- Fixed bug that was preventing volume settings from being saved/loaded properly
- Fixed several instances of stuttering during certain VFX

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.9.1
notes.notes:
- Changed colour of reload bar from red to blue
- Various balance changes for Behemoth boss
- Tutorial text prompts appear less often
- Added text tooltips for precision fire, quick reload, and dash

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.9.0
notes.notes:
- Added first boss
- Reloading manually no longer triggers a freeze frame
- Fixed bug where true sight portal was the wrong size when playing at certain resolutions

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.8.3
notes.notes:
- Taking damage from multiple sources in a very short time should no longer slow down the game’s speed
- Several small performance optimizations
- Fixed more visual glitches in some UI icons

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.8.2
notes.notes:
- Equipped perks are displayed in the pause menu
- Extra projectile blessings now give twice as many additional projectiles and they deal half of your base damage
- Smoother camera movement when dashing
- Fixed a few visual glitches with several icons

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.8.1
notes.notes: - UI icons should be less jagged when playing at lower resolutions

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.8.0
notes.notes:
- 10 new perks
- New system for unlocking additional perks beyond the first row by completing different objectives

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.7.0
notes.notes:
- New system for equipping perks.
- The perk that gave a random chance for free precision ammo has been changed to instead increase rate of precision ammo generation.
- Decreased damage bonus on the quick reload perk.

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.6.2
notes.notes:
- Visual tweaks to true sight portal
- Fixed true sight portal dimensions when playing at certain resolutions

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.6.1
notes.notes:
- New build compression method. This will result in an increase to overall install size, but going forward most update download sizes should be significantly decreased. 
- Removed feedback form option from the menu
- Removed old reference to secondary fire from help screen text
- Fixed bug where XP pickups spawned from extra XP blessings had no collision detection

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.6.0
notes.notes:
- Two new blessing categories (8 new blessings total). One cateogry based on vision, the other on XP pickups. 
- New pulser VFX when pulsing and misfiring, to make it easier to know which state the pulser is in
- New XP pickup visuals
- Improved visual feedback when casting spells
- Increased charging speed of charge shot blessing
- Improved octo enemy collision detection
- Improved precision fire SFX
- Fixed bug where turret enemy collision was sometimes not enabling until a few seconds after spawning

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.5.1
notes.notes:
- If no enemies are left alive at any point in the run, additional enemies are spawned
- Improvements to wyrm projectile hit detection
- Trail VFX on player spell projectiles
- Fixed bug where enemy spawn SFX was sometimes triggering multiple times per spawn

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.5.0
notes.notes:
- Selectable primary fire types
- Primary fire now uses a more traditional ammo system instead of a constantly recharging meter
- Removed secondary fire
- Improved precision fire hit detection
- Increased damage bonus from ignited status effect
- Various SFX and VFX tweaks

Bug fixes:
- Getting hit by two explosions at the same no longer sets the time scale to 0
- Timed stat modifiers are now properly removed at the end of their duration
- Enemy explosions no longer damage the player even when outside of their range

notes.title: Patch notes - Version 0.4.0
notes.notes:
- Poisoned status effect. Poisoned enemies take damage over time. 
- Chilled and Frozen status effects. Chilled enemies move slower. Chilling an already chilled enemy freezes them, completely stopping all movement and attacks. 
- Two new blessing categories for the new status effects (8 new blessings) 
- Precision fire blessing category (4 new blessings) 
- Increasing the number of precision projectiles per shot now fires them simultaneously in a horizontal spread, instead of a burst. 

- Dash pulse blessing now triggers on every other dash, and on every dash if blighted
- New icon for dash attack blessing
- Replaced placeholder icons for ignite and shock blessings
- Slightly reduced font size of blessing descriptions in the level up UI
- Playtest disclaimer screen won't be shown on startup if you've already seen it
- Lots of minor VFX tweaks

- Fixed bug where chain lightning was sometimes hitting the enemy it was originating from
- Fixed bug where electric heavy spell wasn't triggering extra chain lightning jumps or the shocked status effect
- Fixed bug where max health of healing crystals was being affected by blights that increase enemy health
- Fixed bug where you could sometimes still cast spells while in the precision aiming state

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.3.1
notes.notes:
- Fire trail blessing now triggers when dashing while your stamina is at least half full, instead of only when your stamina is completely full
- Various VFX tweaks

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.3.0
notes.notes:
- "Ignited" status effect. Enemies that are ignited take increased damage from all sources. 
- "Shocked" status effect. Enemies that die while shocked have a chance to trigger chain lightning. 
- Two new blessing categories, one all about igniting enemies, the other about shocking them (8 new blessings total). 
- Improved tentacle tech. Now more tentacle-y than ever.
- Lightning bolt VFX now looks much more like lightning and less like just a glowing straight line
- VFX when casting electric heavy spell  
- Increased speed of cast VFX for grenade light spell
  
- Fixed health crystals not despawning when a run ends  
- Fixed bug where turrets would sometimes not trigger hit flash effect when hit  
- Fixed bug where aiming and/or dashing would sometimes reset FOV to default settings

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.2.13
notes.notes:
- XP pickup spawn behaviour is significantly more consistent (should no longer fly across the arena or fall through the floor)
- If an enemy dies outside of the arena then any XP pickups it spawns will land at the edge of the arena
- Turret spawn SFX can be heard from further away
- Turrets are more visible after the player level up sequence
- The 'dashing creates a pulse' blessing now spawns a pulse that remains stationary instead of following the player
- Additional precision fire VFX

- Fixed bug where turrets could still shoot you even if they died during their spawn phase
- Fixed bug where player's precision fire was getting blocked by enemy projectiles
- Fixed bug where turrets would sometimes spawn overlapping with environment geometry
- Fixed several VFX and UI elements rendering on top of the blessing selection menu
- Fixed some visual glitches with the precision fire projectile when firing at certain angles

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.2.12
notes.notes:
- Health crystals. These crystals have a chance to spawn when killing an enemy. Destroying them restores a small amount of health.
- New mobility blessing, replacing the increase dash distance blessing
- New model for the arena boundary markers
- New crystal explosion VFX
- Secondary fire is now on its own input
- UI icon for seondary fire showing its input key and ready status
- Increased size of turret collider
- Decreased turret turn speed
- Run timer
- Decreased amount of shards earned from taking a blight
- Moved help screen to the pause menu
- Better build compression (total file size reduced by about 50%)
- Fixed stamina empty SFX playing multiple times very quickly if repeatedly losing stamina
- Fixed bug where some menu buttons weren't functioning correctly until starting and exiting a run
- Fixed bug where active blight UI wasn't clearing at the end of a run
- Fixed bug where spells were not despawning at the end of a run
- Fixed bug where killing an octo during an animation where its scale was increased caused it to remain at that increased scale when respawning
- Fixed bug where sometimes the game would not be paused during blessing selection
- Fixed bug where player level was sometimes not resetting when starting a new run

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.2.11
notes.notes:
- [b]Blights[/b]. Blessings will sometimes come with a blight, which applies a debuff for a moderate duration in exchange for more powerful buffs from the blessing. 
- Movement trail VFX on XP pickups
- Spell UI flashes red if trying to use it when it's not ready
- Minor UI tweaks
- Optimized SFX virtualization and culling for better overall performance
- Fixed looping issues on some enemy SFX
- Fixed electric bolts not accurately targeting some enemies
- Fixed blessing UI being active when starting a new run if player died at a specific time during the level up sequence

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.2.9
notes.notes:
- Explosions and some abilities trigger screen shake, with intensity based on distance from the player to the tirggering effect. 
- SFX for the electric heavy spell.

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.2.8
notes.notes:
- All blessings no longer use placeholder icons
- Rewording of some blessing descriptions

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.2.7
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug where text prompts weren't clearing from the screen.

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.2.6
notes.notes:
- On screen text reminding players how to pulse if the pulse input has not been pressed for a while. 
- "Survive" text briefly appears on screen after initiating a run. 
- "Press F1 for Help" text starts out really big in the center of the screen on your first run, to make sure new players don't miss it.

notes.title: Patch notes - version 0.2.5
notes.notes:
- New keyboard and mouse input icons. 
- The 'shoot' input icon appears under the quick reload bar. 
- Tutorial popups don't show again if they've already been seen (you can reset their seen status by toggling "Show Tutorials" off and on in the settings menu). 
- Lowered the max instances of primary fire SFX to prevent it from overpowering all other audio when multi-projectile and increased fire rate blessings are both selected.
